ideas.title: Investigation into ICE arrest of Hmong American man as possible kidnapping
ideas.description: This story would investigate the circumstances surrounding the arrest of ChongLy Scott Thao, a Hmong American man, by ICE agents.
ideas.angle: The potential kidnapping and treatment of individuals by federal officers
questions: What were the circumstances surrounding the arrest?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it raises concerns over the treatment of individuals by federal officers, particularly those of Hmong descent. Further investigation is needed to determine the circumstances surrounding the arrest.

ideas.title: $11M Minnesota fraud case
ideas.description: This story would investigate the $11M Minnesota fraud case, including the suspect and the circumstances surrounding the fraud.
questions: Who was involved in the fraud?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it raises concerns over large-scale fraud in Minnesota. Further investigation is needed to determine the extent of the fraud and identify those involved.
